spotify.create_playlist passes its non-idempotent POST through api_write's 5xx retry loop. A fake transport that raises HTTP 500 on the first POST and returns an id on the second causes two creation requests; if Spotify created the first playlist before losing the response, Refresh leaves an orphan and creates a second Duet, violating create-once and the risky network-write safety requirement. Rule: An ambiguous failure of playlist creation must not automatically issue another creation POST without a way to prove the first did not create a playlist.. Scope: duetflow/spotify.py::create_playlist and api_write retry policy for POST /me/playlists, plus duetflow/playlist.py::ensure_duet_playlist and its create-once tests.. Verify: Use a fake transport whose first creation POST raises HTTP 500 or loses its response after simulated creation; assert the Refresh does not issue a second creation POST and does not claim a unique persisted Duet id without resolving the ambiguous outcome..
